notes.title: Now Available - Desolate City: The Bloody Dawn
notes.notes:
Tribute to Resident Evil series, Desolate City is an adventure game set after an outbreak in a city called Gray Bay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/965410/

The game now supports achievements, cloud service, joysticks, and multiplatform(Mac/Linux), there's also a 10% launch discount for the first week only. We wish you will enjoy this retro RPG experience.

Thank you for your support.
